purpose: Ten electricity grid operators' public fuel-mix dashboards for the hero job: public pages only, no login, no paywall. Each entry says which chart the numbers are read from, and where the operator publishes the same mix as data, so the snapshot can show vision's reading beside the published one.

excluded.why: its dashboard sits behind a Cloudflare bot check that a headless browser does not pass
the Current Grid Conditions page carries a status graphic, not a fuel-mix chart
its real-time displays answer 403 to a plain request
the eco2mix page I found answers a soft 404 in a browser
its control-room page shows flows and prices, not a generation mix
the real-time page I tried answered 'page not found'
